UPDATE "InvestmentHolding"
              SET "name" = COALESCE(?1, "name"),
                  "ticker" = CASE WHEN ?2 THEN ?3 ELSE "ticker" END,
                  "type" = ?4,
                  "quantity" = COALESCE(?5, "quantity"),
                  "costBasis" = CASE WHEN ?6 THEN ?7 ELSE "costBasis" END,
                  "custodianId" = ?8,
                  "walletId" = ?9,
                  "updatedAt" = ?10
            WHERE "id" = ?11
